caseName: PDR Network, LLC v. Carlton & Harris Chiropractic, Inc.
caseNameFull: PDR NETWORK, LLC v. CARLTON & HARRIS CHIROPRACTIC, INC.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit granted limited to the following question: Whether the Hobbs Act required the district court in this case to accept the FCC's legal interpretation of the Telephone Consumer Protection Act.
